review_candidates.description: Job Responsibilities Do you have a passion for Information Technology? Are you looking to learn new technologies? Then we may have the job for you! We aren’t looking for your “average” IT person. We need a cut above. The ideal candidate would be a team player who can work across departments to service and support a variety of computer systems and peripherals. Here at the SCDMV we value teamwork, commitment and excellent customer service. Come join us and find the keys to your future! This position is in the IT / System Shared Services Unit, at SCDMV Headquarters in Blythewood, SC. Responsibilities Of The Network Technician II With supervision: responsible to configure, deploy, install, monitor, troubleshoot and maintain the agency's switching and routing infrastructure devices and software. Reviews switch, router and other device logs in order to ensure industry best practices and standards are maintained throughout the data network. Using logs and management tools, identifies, and reports to management any troubles, unusual traffic patterns, software misconfigurations, unsafe security practices, and/or suspected abuse or misuse of computer or network resources and maintain record of said logs. Under limited supervision monitor network resources to ensure detected problems are quickly corrected. Use system software to determine network status. Configure and upgrade network management software on Network Operation Center servers. Coordinates with third party service providers for orders of new service, trouble reporting and resolution of troubles and outages to include data/voice/power. Supports other SCDMV IT resources with end-user network troubles and requests for service. Fills Moves/Add/Change requests, performs trouble resolution, and with supervision carries out business-related engineering tasks. Assists with WLAN configurations, remote connectivity user configurations, VPN user setup and trouble resolution. Coordinates these efforts with third party service providers as necessary. A point of contact for all cell phone and agency-issued handheld device activation/service changes/deactivations. Responsible for troubleshooting all reported troubles on these devices. Coordinates with third party service providers as necessary. Assist in the design, implementation, and management of Agency LAN/WAN/WLAN network construction. Maintains accurate, detailed documentation of network architecture; network device configurations; and trouble incidents and resolutions. Assist in the support of the Agency telephony, to include moves/adds/changes, trouble reporting and resolution. Other duties as required. Minimum Requirements Minimum and Additional Requirements A high school diploma and experience in information technology, electronics technology systems, or other related areas. An associate degree or bachelor's degree in a related field may be substituted for the required experience. Must possess excellent written and verbal skills. Additional Requirements Working knowledge of Windows networking, including domain administration, security, communication protocols and LAN/WAN devices. Knowledge/Ability to install, configure, manage, monitor, troubleshoot/repair network devices (switches, routers, CSU/DSU's). Knowledge/Ability to use software (packet sniffers, vendor-specific tools), SNMP and other performance monitoring tools to monitor, manage, detect trouble and maintain the security/integrity of the DMV data network. Knowledge/Ability to coordinate with service providers in resolution of trouble issues. Ability to interpret/apply rules/regulations. Effective communication skills. Works under the general guidance of the Network Operations Center Manager. Employee has general discretion to use own good judgement in accordance with industry Best Practices and Agency procedures. Position involves access to information containing citizens' driver/vehicle records and other computerized data. May require overnight travel. Will be required to keep state-provided cell phone on and near the person at all times. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted. CCNA certification or equivalent. Additional Comments What’s in it for you? At the SCDMV you get to be part of exceptional team and diverse culture that nurtures mutual success for our customers, employees and our communities. We give you the tools to be successful; all you need to do is bring your best ideas, your energy and a desire to develop your skills, experience and career. Health, dental, vision, long term disability, and life insurance for employees, spouse and children (also available for temporary employees working over 30 hours per week) 15 days annual (vacation) leave per year 15 days sick leave per year 13 paid holidays State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs (optional for Temporary Employees) An exceptional Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost to the employee or members of their household So, what are you waiting for? We're excited to hear from everyone with the skills, experience, and passion to do a great job. Supplemental questions are considered part of your official application. Any misrepresentation will result in your disqualification from employment. Please complete the state application to include all current and previous work history and education. Examiner et interpréter les alertes de sécurité et fournir des diagnostics dans la gestion des incidents pour soutenir les clients. Selon la nature de la menace à la sécurité, évaluer et élaborer des mesures d’atténuation pour s’assurer que le traitement approprié est appliqué, et veiller à ce que les clients soient informés. Prendre des mesures proactives pour gérer tout l’équipement de sécurité périmétrique ou les composants associés qui pourraient être interrompus ou affectés par des menaces ou des vulnérabilités. Configurer, installer, gérer et maintenir les dispositifs de sécurité et fournir des savoir plus et des recommandations sur les meilleures pratiques de sécurité. Élaborer la documentation associée aux versions de maintenance et les tenir à jour. Observer les meilleures pratiques de gestion de la sécurité. Qualifications Essentielles Achèvement d’un programme universitaire ou collégial en informatique; ou 5 ans d’expérience équivalente dans le domaine des systèmes d’information. Expérience avérée dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et le dépannage de solutions de sécurité, y compris les capacités d’authentification, d’autorisation, de chiffrement et d’audit dans le cadre d’une conception globale du système. Expérience pratique reconnue dans la mise en œuvre, la gestion quotidienne et le dépannage de pare-feu de plusieurs fournisseurs. Expérience avérée dans la gestion quotidienne et le dépannage des systèmes de détection et de prévention des intrusions (IPS). Expérience dans le dépannage de solutions de sécurité, y compris les capacités d’authentification, d’autorisation et de chiffrement ainsi que la sécurisation de l’accès aux appareils. Expérience de la traduction de problèmes complexes et ambigus en composants exploitables. Capacité à travailler sur plusieurs clients et plusieurs technologies. Être capable de travailler sous pression (requis lors d’incidents). Bonnes compétences en communication, rédaction et présentations. Autonome avec d’excellentes compétences organisationnelles et interpersonnelles. Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et en français (écrit et parlé). Qualifications Souhaitées Certifications de sécurité pratiques des principaux fournisseurs. Expérience de travail avec les consoles de gestion de la sécurité suivantes : Checkpoint, Juniper, Cisco, Tufin, Fortinet, Mc Afee, Arcsight, etc. Connaissance des tactiques opérationnelles de sécurité offensive et défensive. Compréhension de NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL, SAS70 (ou 5970) et/ou d’autres cadres de conformité. Connaissance de la gestion des événements d’information de sécurité (SIEM). Une connaissance adéquate du français est requise pour les postes offerts au Québec. Le générique masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d'alléger le texte.
